title: Typed refusal (error response)
description: Returned by HQ, the broker, the identity service, or soul build in place of a result. Source: draft 0.4, Appendix A, Minimum error codes: errors include a safe explanation and correlation ID without exposing credentials or private content. The code enumeration is errors/registry.json, in registry order (validate.py checks they match). additionalProperties is false, so a refusal cannot carry a token, a payload, or a stack trace.

explanation.description: Safe for the caller to read and log: names the failed check, never a credential, private content, or another member's data.

correlation_id.description: Joins this refusal to HQ's receipt and logs for the owner and agent-watcher.

request_id.description: Echo of the refused request's ID when it had one.

retry_after_seconds.description: Only for codes registered as retryable; when the caller may try again.
